name: h4 · Traces
description: The traces worth opening: the costliest and the slowest by trace ID, spend and failures by endpoint, and how latency and tokens spread across the model calls. A trace is one request: a turn, a hello, or an admin call.

widgets.name: The costliest traces
widgets.description: The 20 traces that cost the most over the dashboard's range, in USD, by trace ID; open one at /project/h4reet-<stack>/traces/<ID>. The cost is the gateway's own price (config/prices.yaml; 0 for local calls). The authoritative spend and the meter's ceilings, prod's $5.00 a day and $20.00 a month and the laptop's $2.00-a-day fallback sub-budget (config/budgets.yaml), are Grafana's "Spend" row.

widgets.name: The slowest traces
widgets.description: The 20 slowest traces over the dashboard's range, in milliseconds, by trace ID: a trace's longest observation is its root, the whole request at the gateway. Open one at /project/h4reet-<stack>/traces/<ID> to see which call took the time. Grafana's "Latency p50 and p95" is the requests' latency over time.

widgets.name: Spend by endpoint
widgets.description: Spend by endpoint over the dashboard's range, in USD: a trace's name is the gateway route that made the calls (POST /room/turn for the twin's turns, POST /hello, and the admin routes the live runs use). The cost is the gateway's own price (config/prices.yaml; 0 for local calls). The authoritative spend and the meter's ceilings, prod's $5.00 a day and $20.00 a month and the laptop's $2.00-a-day fallback sub-budget (config/budgets.yaml), are Grafana's "Spend" row; Grafana's "Cost per feature, today" splits the turns' spend by feature.

widgets.name: Model latency spread
widgets.description: How the model calls' latency spreads over the dashboard's range, in milliseconds, in 20 bins: a second hump is usually the paid fallback, or the local model under load.

widgets.name: Failed model calls by endpoint
widgets.description: Failed model calls by endpoint over the dashboard's range, in calls: attempts whose span ended in error, by the route that made them. Grafana's "Turn errors by feature" counts the turns that failed.

widgets.name: Input tokens per model call
widgets.description: How many input tokens a model call sends, spread over the dashboard's range, in tokens, in 20 bins: the twin's pack and the conversation so far, so it grows with a conversation's length.

widgets.name: Output tokens per model call
widgets.description: How many output tokens a model call returns, spread over the dashboard's range, in tokens, in 20 bins: a pile at the right edge is answers cut at the output cap (300 for a turn, 128 for a hello; config/budgets.yaml).
